verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own policy and approval workflows: policy rules automatically flag or decline transactions and route them to approvers. That is a domain-specific form of rule-triggered action. Webhooks are listed only as an API surface, with no rule-definition semantics, and there is no evidence of a general event-to-action automation builder. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose rule/trigger builder, a description of which events can trigger rules, configurable automated actions beyond approval and flagging, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
